lines.zh: 绿袍拖在地上，一路擦出声。
lines.en: My green robe drags along the ground, scraping.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，身上的石很重。
lines.en: I walk slowly; the stone on me is heavy.

lines.zh: 我一步踏下去，草都折了。
lines.en: When I set my foot down, the grass bends.
I'm not like those originium worms.

lines.zh: 绿袍擦过矿脉，发出细响。
lines.en: My green robe brushes the vein with a thin sound.
Under the green robe, originium glows.
I go around the rubble.
A crust of crystal lines my hem.
No shadow follows me.

lines.zh: 我的脚印很快长满晶粒。
lines.en: Crystals soon fill my footprints.
I head toward the village.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方有机器的响。
lines.en: A machine sound follows where I walk.
I stand by the ore without moving.
The crystals on me grow slowly.

lines.zh: 我袖中的矿已经长成手指。
lines.en: The ore in my sleeve has grown into fingers.

lines.zh: 时间在我身上结成了壳。
lines.en: Time has crusted into a shell on me.

lines.zh: 风声从我袍子里穿过去。
lines.en: The wind passes through my robe.
I'm listening to the sound in the ore.

lines.zh: 袍袖滑下，露出一截矿臂。
lines.en: My sleeve slips, showing an arm of ore.
This hand isn't a hand anymore.
I have stood by the vein a long while.
Under this green robe, originium grows.
You carry the smell of originium.

lines.zh: 我抬头，帽檐下面没有眼。
lines.en: I look up, and there are no eyes under the brim.
The ore here knows your blood.

lines.zh: 我这身绿袍，已经和源石长在一起。
lines.en: This green robe has fused with originium.
Can what you hold hurt me?
We're standing very close.

lines.zh: 我不说话，是因为说不好。
lines.en: I don't speak because I speak badly.
Your shadow is on my robe.
Turn back, and don't come again.

lines.zh: 你的轮廓进了我的矿里。
lines.en: Your outline is in my ore now.
A piece of my crystal has broken.
A piece of my hem is torn away.
Only the stones in my robe make sound.
It slowly grows back.
A tear opens in my robe.
My foot sinks into the vein.
That one landed.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，帽檐下的光暗了。
lines.en: I raise my head, and the glow under my brim dims.

lines.zh: 绿袍上，源石的纹路发亮。
lines.en: The Originium veins on my green robe glow.
I'm still standing, and my crystals still glow.
Under this green robe, all is originium.
Why bring me ore?
I don't eat; I only grow.
The crystal in your hand is too small.
Under this green robe, all is originium.
That much can't replenish me.

lines.zh: 那点矿，不够补我一根指。
lines.en: That bit of ore cannot replace one finger.
Set those farther away.
This won't buy you passage.
Go on, and take your things with you.
You touched my robe.

lines.zh: 我几乎没有动，袍子上的源石结晶挡着。
lines.en: I hardly moved; the Originium crystals on my robe held.
The crystal cut your hand.
I turn and give you one block.
A small shard falls to the ground.
Your hand scraped my hem.
You stepped back; I keep standing.
Don't touch what's on me.
At that touch I heard a sound.

lines.zh: 我的袍角在你脚边结了晶。
lines.en: Crystal forms at my hem by your feet.
Another of me is growing in the ore.
It hasn't stood up yet.
I crouch beside it.
We share one name.
The crystals join us into one.
I'll be here when it wakes.
This mine belongs to us.
We don't speak; we only listen.
The ore will grow faster than we do.
We wait together.
I reach out with the hand inside my sleeve.

lines.zh: 它在我的掌心里陷进去。
lines.en: It sinks into my palm.
I use it as a walking staff.
This is too heavy; I set it down.
I plant it in the soil.
It grows into my crystals.

lines.zh: 它映出我帽檐下的空无。
lines.en: It reflects the emptiness under my hat.
I drop it into the ore.

lines.zh: 这东西碰到我的晶就黑了。
lines.en: It blackens where it touches my crystal.

lines.zh: 我把它嵌进袍子上的凹处。
lines.en: I set it into the hollow in my robe.
You've walked onto the vein.

lines.zh: 我转过身，绿袍扫起一层矿灰。
lines.en: I turn and my green robe sweeps up ore dust.
The ground is beginning to glow.
Crystals are forming under your feet.
I raise my hand and the crystals move.

lines.zh: 你身上已经开始结晶了。
lines.en: Crystals have started on you already.
This stretch of ore is mine to keep.
Running will only hurt more.
I keep the vent's location.
There's a glimmer under my brim.
You're standing on an ore vent.

lines.zh: 矿眼睁开时，你站着别动。
lines.en: When the ore eye opens, stand still.

lines.zh: 晶簇从我的袍子里长出来。
lines.en: Crystals grow out through my robe.

lines.zh: 你的影子被矿吞了一半。
lines.en: Half your shadow is swallowed by the ore.
We're very close now.

lines.zh: 我的动作慢，落下的晶很快。
lines.en: My motion is slow; the falling crystal is quick.
I close in a block at a time.
Crystals grow up from the ground.
One block per step.
This green robe of mine has turned to originium.

lines.zh: 袍子扫过地面，晶跟着起来。
lines.en: My robe sweeps the ground and crystals rise.

lines.zh: 我的绿袍上，结了一层源石。
lines.en: A crust of Originium has formed on my green robe.

lines.zh: 你背后有一块凸出来的。
lines.en: There's an outcrop behind you.

lines.zh: 我袖子里的矿先一步伸出来。
lines.en: The ore in my sleeve reaches out first.
The dust in the air is glowing.

lines.zh: 你听得见地上的响声吗？
lines.en: Do you hear the ground ringing?

lines.zh: 绿袍拖在地上，每一步都压折草。
lines.en: My green robe trails, folding grass with every step.
Your feet have been caught.

lines.zh: 你脚下每块矿都在告诉我。
lines.en: Every ore under your feet tells me.
You're backing away faster now.
My brim sits even lower.
The vent is beneath your feet.
Your heel meets the ore wall.
You have one step left to take.
After this step, we arrive.

lines.zh: 矿晶在你脚踝边绕了一圈。
lines.en: Crystal coils once around your ankle.
I press a palm down.
Crystals lance out of my sleeve.
You're driven back three steps.
My palm sinks into a seam of your armor.

lines.zh: 我的掌印留在坑底，亮着。
lines.en: My palm print stays in the pit, glowing.

lines.zh: 绿袍一甩，我只出了半力。
lines.en: One sweep of green robes, half strength only.
Your arm is starting to stiffen.

lines.zh: 袍子裂口里，矿又补了上来。
lines.en: Ore fills the tear in my robe.
Your blood drips onto the ore.
The ore absorbs it.
The crystal on this hand is thicker.

lines.zh: 绿布里露出密密麻麻的晶簇。
lines.en: Tight clusters of crystal show through the green cloth.
You fall back another block.
You slipped under my elbow.
I press your shoulder.
You're sinking.
I swing again.
This time you blocked it.
My other hand hasn't moved yet.
The green-robed elder, originium-touched.
I rise out of the vein.
My green robe is covered in crystal.
The ground here has changed.
I lift my brim.
The vent begins to glow.
I haven't moved in a long time.

lines.zh: 我朝有人的方向看一眼。
lines.en: I look toward where the people are.
The stones on the ground shift aside.
I take my first step.
I hear a machine's sound.
I press the soil firm underfoot.
I press down on the ground as I go.

lines.zh: 火把袍角点着了，我不去扑。
lines.en: Fire catches my hem, and I don't put it out.

lines.zh: 我从矿壁摔下，碎了一身。
lines.en: I fall from the ore wall and shatter.

lines.zh: 水灌进裂缝，我的动作慢下来。
lines.en: Water fills the cracks and my movement slows.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀开矿层，我被埋住半个身子。
lines.en: The blast opens the ore and buries half of me.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的胸口，扎在晶上。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the crystal on my chest.

lines.zh: 那股力把我的晶压住不长。
lines.en: That force stops my crystals from growing.

lines.zh: 我不进食，只是在慢慢耗尽。
lines.en: I don't feed; I'm simply running down.

lines.zh: 雷顺着矿脉打到我身上。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the vein into me.
The ore is gone and I fall.
